verification_instructions: Run npm run build and confirm zero errors. Visually verify components render correctly.
environment_constraints: Full internet access available. No test framework configured - verification via build only.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: components in src/components/<feature>/, pages in src/pages/, state in AppContext with localStorage persistence via src/lib/storage.js, icons from lucide-react, styling via Tailwind CSS v4.
key_patterns: AppContext provides global state with useState + localStorage write-through. Each page is a top-level component in src/pages/. Feature components live in src/components/<feature>/. Layout uses fixed sidebar (220px) with main content area. Routes defined in App.jsx within a Layout wrapper. All data persistence uses getData/setData helpers from src/lib/storage.js with 'propela_ops_' prefix.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (routes), src/components/layout/ (Layout, Sidebar), src/components/<feature>/ (feature components), src/pages/ (page-level components), src/context/AppContext.jsx (global state), src/lib/ (storage, constants, calculations), src/data/ (seed data)
